title: Advanced Cherrypicking Protocol for Liquid Transfers
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .CSV file with the required headers (step_id, instruction, instruction_parameters, source_labware, etc.) and format it exactly as shown in the protocol examples, ensuring each row defines a single instruction.

steps.title: Select pipettes for mounts
steps.instruction: In the protocol setup, choose the pipette type to mount on the left side and the pipette type to mount on the right side.

steps.title: Choose tip types
steps.instruction: Specify for each pipette whether to use filter tips or standard tips.

steps.title: Set tip usage strategy
steps.instruction: Decide if a new tip will be used for each transfer or if the same tip will be kept throughout the protocol, and set this option in the protocol parameters.

steps.title: Upload CSV to protocol
steps.instruction: Load the prepared CSV file into the protocol interface and start the run.

steps.title: Validate CSV and volumes
steps.instruction: The protocol automatically checks that all CSV fields are valid and that no well will be filled beyond 80 % of its maximum volume; if any overflow is detected, the protocol reports the offending step IDs, warns the user, and aborts execution.

steps.title: Execute transfer instructions
steps.instruction: For each row with instruction = transfer, the pipette aspirates the specified volume from the source labware/well (calculating aspiration height for tubes), optionally adds an air gap, optionally touches the tip to the source well, then dispenses the liquid into the destination well (dispensing above the liquid level for tubes) and performs any requested blow‑out.

steps.title: Execute aspirate‑and‑park instructions
steps.instruction: For each row with instruction = aspirate_and_park_tip, the pipette aspirates the indicated volume from the source well and parks the tip for later retrieval.

steps.title: Execute pause instructions
steps.instruction: For each row with instruction = pause, the protocol pauses for the specified time (e.g., 5 m 30 s).

steps.title: Execute dispense‑parked‑tip instructions
steps.instruction: For each row with instruction = dispense_parked_tip, the protocol retrieves the tip that was previously parked (identified by its step_id) and dispenses its contents into the designated destination well.

steps.title: Complete protocol run
steps.instruction: Continue processing rows until all instructions in the CSV have been executed, then finish the run.
